mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 0.2 percentage points monthly rise indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which signals weakening corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS show growth.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals a potential economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts above 0.5% indicates a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment and rising unemployment indicates a labor market mismatch, which signals economic instability and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS grows and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized), strong economic momentum supports corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized.
